messages:
mira: release-bot just blocked the JS SDK publish — regendiff flagged a breaking API change from typegen run, anyone free to look?
release-bot: automated check: publish blocked for @redwood/sdk-js. Regendiff indicates removal of an optional property (semver-major). Please add changelog or restore compatibility.
jordan: which property? can you paste the small diff?
mira: here — ran locally:
```diff
-  userHandle?: string | null; // deprecated in spec v2
+  // removed in spec v3
```
sam: wow, that looks like a straight removal. typegen should have emitted a deprecated alias instead. what generator version ran in CI?
riya: CI used openapi-typescript 9.0.0 after the yarn upgrade earlier this week. I saw a nullability mapping change in the release notes that could cause removals to be interpreted as deletes.
alex: this also explains why the sample-app onboarding e2e started failing — client.auth retry signature changed and our sample sdk code references userHandle. stacktrace in sample-app CI: `TypeError: client.createUser(...).userHandle is undefined`
mira: ok blocking publish and staging tests. can we either pin the generator back in CI or add a compatibility shim in the typegen output? we need a quick unblock rather than a major release.
jordan: quick mitigation: add a compatibility alias in the generated types, keep `userHandle?: string | null` and mark it @deprecated, while mapping to the new `username` field at runtime. small patch in codegen templates should do it.
sam: I can open a PR with the template change + regen and tests. will also add a small unit test that verifies deprecated alias exists.
riya: alternatively we could pin openapi-typescript to 8.x in the release pipeline until we fully audit the spec change. pinning is faster but feels like a bandaid.
mira: either is fine for unblock, but we must also fix the underlying spec drift. @riya can you check the spec commit that removed the deprecated field and either restore the deprecation marker or add a migration note?
riya: already on it — looks like the spec maintainer removed fields when migrating to v3 without leaving a deprecation period. I can open a PR to reintroduce the deprecated path with a deprecation flag and link to the migration note.
devex-bot: reminder: create a release-blocker tag on the PR so CI knows to re-run full integration tests once merged (see #release-process).
jordan: proposed PR title: "typegen: compat alias for removed userHandle to avoid semver-major on publish". I'll draft description and link to regendiff output.
sam: drafting now. will include patch and `yarn regen --ci` results. expected outcome: regendiff shows no removed properties and publish unblocks (patch semver).
mira: also add a changelog entry explaining compatibility shim and that we'll remove alias after one release. avoids surprising customers.
alex: I'll update sample-app to use `username` internally but keep asserts for userHandle until next minor. PR incoming.
riya: CI note — after the authoring PR merges, run `./scripts/regendiff --ci` and then trigger publish-bot recheck.
mira: thanks all. @sam ping me when PR is up and I'll kick the sample-app staging run.
sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/4923 (WIP). includes tests + regen.
devex-bot: CI started for PR #4923 (build 7872).
jordan: awesome, thanks. once CI passes we can re-run the publish check.
mira: great work. please leave a TODO to revert shim in 2 releases. :thumbsup:
sam: noted. will add TODO in PR description.
riya: FYI I'll follow up with the spec owners about adding a proper deprecation policy so this doesn't recur.
alex: ack, monitoring sample-app staging after merge.
mira: closing the loop — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
